profile.memory_method: Sum live Nsight DEVICE allocations minus matching releases; final live set empty. Excludes mapped files, driver and OS storage; UMA is not CPU RAM plus VRAM.
profile.scope: One artifact/flags-specific trace; exact identity is in receipt.json. Attribution is not another unprofiled A/B run. Runtime API durations overlap GPU work. max32 slot use measures weight-reuse capacity; MMA already skips unused n8 subtiles.

profile_proof.scope: Profile consistency with same final plain candidate; no new broad arithmetic/quality claim

target_comparison.scope: Old KV_B expansion precedes positions and is counted in dense; candidate absorbed projections follow positions and are counted in attention. Combine these regions and subtract KDA for a comparable DSA target. Whole off/on gain uses fresh same-binary plain runs; profile totals alone are not another A/B.

open_scope: 2K eager text only; no HTTP TTFT,8K/indexer,MTP,capture,image,live tool/multiturn,banks,snapshots or diskKV qualification. A one-row prefill tail may select N1 path; measured mult-row prefill unchanged. Old Q4 quantization observations are accepted by user, not repeated gates.

"""Bounded prototype: target timing plus independent per-operation BF16 error budgets."""
import ctypes as ct
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parents[1]/'tools'))
from glm_vq_q4k import bf16_round
lib=ct.CDLL(str(p/'liblatent_probe.so'));fn=lib.bench_latent
fn.argtypes=[ct.c_void_p]*7+[ct.c_uint32]*4+[ct.POINTER(ct.c_float)];fn.restype=ct.c_int
raw=(p/'kv-b.bf16').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='f0540a2685b23735442058523c7fca84e6e58096b06db07fa7d2725616d8c7de'
w=np.frombuffer(raw,'<u2').copy()
def expand(x):return (x.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32)
def packed(x):return (bf16_round(x).view(np.uint32)>>16).astype(np.uint16)
wf=expand(w).astype(np.float64).reshape(64,2,256,512)
rng=np.random.default_rng(5353);cache=packed(rng.normal(size=(1985,512)).astype(np.float32));query=bf16_round(rng.normal(size=(64,256)).astype(np.float32))
u=2.**-24
def gamma(n):return (n+32)*u/(1-(n+32)*u)
def half_ulp(x):return np.exp2(np.floor(np.log2(np.maximum(np.abs(x),2.**-126)))-8)
def budget(ref,absolute,n):return gamma(n)*absolute+half_ulp(ref)+2.**-126
def check(label,actual,ref,bound):
 error=np.abs(actual-ref);ratio=error/bound
 assert np.isfinite(actual).all() and np.all(error<=bound),(label,float(ratio.max()),np.unravel_index(ratio.argmax(),ratio.shape))
 return dict(max_abs=float(error.max()),max_bound_ratio=float(ratio.max()))
rows=[]
for keys,pos,repeats in [(32,31,704),(128,127,704),(512,511,704),(1024,1023,704),(1985,1984,704),(33,26,1)]:
 c=np.ascontiguousarray(cache[:keys]);x=expand(c).astype(np.float64);outputs=[];stages=None;times=[]
 for mode in [0,1]:
  out=np.empty((64,256),np.float32);ql=np.empty((64,512),np.uint16);probs=np.empty((64,keys),np.uint16);low=np.empty((64,512),np.uint16);ms=ct.c_float()
  rc=fn(w.ctypes.data,c.ctypes.data,query.ctypes.data,out.ctypes.data,ql.ctypes.data,probs.ctypes.data,low.ctypes.data,keys,pos,repeats,mode,ct.byref(ms));assert rc==0,rc
  libraries=sorted({line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines() if any(s in line for s in ['libcuda','libcublas'])})
  expected=json.loads((p/'kv-bf16-profile/loaded-libraries.json').read_text())['libraries'];assert libraries==expected,(libraries,expected)
  outputs.append(out.astype(np.float64));times.append(ms.value)
  if mode:stages=[expand(z).astype(np.float64) for z in [ql,probs,low]]
 ql,probs,low=stages;q=query.astype(np.float64)
 qref=np.einsum('hd,hdl->hl',q,wf[:,0],optimize=True);qa=np.einsum('hd,hdl->hl',np.abs(q),np.abs(wf[:,0]),optimize=True)
 proof={'q_low':check('q_low',ql,qref,budget(qref,qa,256))}
 scores=ql@x.T;absolute=np.abs(ql)@np.abs(x).T;uncertainty=budget(scores,absolute,512)/16+half_ulp(scores/16)
 scaled=scores/16;scaled[:,pos+1:]=-np.inf
 probability=np.exp(scaled-scaled.max(1,keepdims=True));probability/=probability.sum(1,keepdims=True)
 delta=uncertainty[:,:pos+1].max(1,keepdims=True)
 pbound=probability*np.expm1(2*delta)+half_ulp(probability*np.exp(2*delta))+probability*gamma(keys)*8+2.**-126
 proof['probability']=check('probability',probs,probability,pbound)
 assert np.all(probs[:,pos+1:]==0)
 lref=probs@x;la=np.abs(probs)@np.abs(x)
 proof['output_low']=check('output_low',low,lref,budget(lref,la,keys))
 yref=np.einsum('hl,hdl->hd',low,wf[:,1],optimize=True);ya=np.einsum('hl,hdl->hd',np.abs(low),np.abs(wf[:,1]),optimize=True)
 proof['output']=check('output',outputs[1],yref,budget(yref,ya,512))
 error=outputs[1]-outputs[0]
 record=dict(keys=keys,position=pos,repeats=repeats,expanded_ms=times[0],latent_ms=times[1],speedup=times[0]/times[1],source_max_abs=float(np.abs(error).max()),source_rel_rms=float(np.linalg.norm(error)/np.linalg.norm(outputs[0])),component_proof=proof,cache_positions_exact=True)
 rows.append(record);print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
result=dict(rows=rows,libraries=libraries,library_sha256=hashlib.sha256((p/'liblatent_probe.so').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),scope='PrototypeN1 only;actual layer3 KV_B duplicated11times,same syntheticBF16cache/query hot,176warmups. IndependentFP64 peroperator bounds with gamma_(n+32) FP32 and BF16 rounding; probability sensitivity propagated from dot/scale uncertainty. Source-relativeoutput differences informational,notfullmodelquality oradoption. Targetspeed includesprojection+attention,notwholeworkload. Lastcase causalposition insidecache testsfuturemask.',arithmetic='BF16 rounding moves from expandedK/V toQlow andoutputlow; no weight/latentprecisionchange.',clock_policy_mhz=[300,2200])
(p/'latent-prototype-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('LATENT_PROTOTYPE_PASS',flush=True)

"""Bounded prototype: target timing plus independent per-operation BF16 error budgets."""
import ctypes as ct
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parents[1]/'tools'))
from glm_vq_q4k import bf16_round
lib=ct.CDLL(str(p/'liblatent_probe.so'));fn=lib.bench_latent
fn.argtypes=[ct.c_void_p]*7+[ct.c_uint32]*4+[ct.POINTER(ct.c_float)];fn.restype=ct.c_int
raw=(p/'kv-b.bf16').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='f0540a2685b23735442058523c7fca84e6e58096b06db07fa7d2725616d8c7de'
w=np.frombuffer(raw,'<u2').copy()
def expand(x):return (x.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32)
def packed(x):return (bf16_round(x).view(np.uint32)>>16).astype(np.uint16)
wf=expand(w).astype(np.float64).reshape(64,2,256,512)
rng=np.random.default_rng(5353);cache=packed(rng.normal(size=(1985,512)).astype(np.float32));query=bf16_round(rng.normal(size=(64,256)).astype(np.float32))
u=2.**-24
def gamma(n):return (n+32)*u/(1-(n+32)*u)
def half_ulp(x):return np.exp2(np.floor(np.log2(np.maximum(np.abs(x),2.**-126)))-8)
def budget(ref,absolute,n):return gamma(n)*absolute+half_ulp(ref)+2.**-126
def check(label,actual,ref,bound):
 error=np.abs(actual-ref);ratio=error/bound
 assert np.isfinite(actual).all() and np.all(error<=bound),(label,float(ratio.max()),np.unravel_index(ratio.argmax(),ratio.shape))
 return dict(max_abs=float(error.max()),max_bound_ratio=float(ratio.max()))
rows=[]
keys=1985;pos=1984;repeats=32
c=np.ascontiguousarray(cache);x=expand(c).astype(np.float64)
for mode in [1,2]:
 out=np.empty((64,256),np.float32);ql=np.empty((64,512),np.uint16);probs=np.empty((64,keys),np.uint16);low=np.empty((64,512),np.uint16);ms=ct.c_float()
 rc=fn(w.ctypes.data,c.ctypes.data,query.ctypes.data,out.ctypes.data,ql.ctypes.data,probs.ctypes.data,low.ctypes.data,keys,pos,repeats,mode,ct.byref(ms));assert rc==0,rc
 ql,probs,low=[expand(z).astype(np.float64) for z in [ql,probs,low]]
 ref=probs@x;absolute=np.abs(probs)@np.abs(x);bound=budget(ref,absolute,keys)
 error=np.abs(low-ref);ratio=error/bound
 np.savez(p/f'latent-reduction-{mode}.npz',out=out,ql=ql,probs=probs,low=low,ref=ref,bound=bound)
 libraries=sorted({line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines() if any(s in line for s in ['libcuda','libcublas'])})
 assert libraries==json.loads((p/'kv-bf16-profile/loaded-libraries.json').read_text())['libraries']
 record=dict(mode=mode,ms=ms.value,max_error=float(error.max()),max_bound_ratio=float(ratio.max()),outside=int((ratio>1).sum()),cache_positions_exact=True)
 rows.append(record);print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
a=np.load(p/'latent-reduction-1.npz');b=np.load(p/'latent-reduction-2.npz')
comparison={k:dict(max_abs=float(np.abs(a[k]-b[k]).max()),rel_rms=float(np.linalg.norm(a[k]-b[k])/np.linalg.norm(b[k]))) for k in ['out','ql','probs','low']}
assert rows[1]['outside']==0
(p/'latent-reduction-diagnosis.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(rows=rows,comparison=comparison,libraries=libraries,diagnosis='Default cuBLAS allows output-precision split reductions; disallow mode passes original FP32 accumulation bound. Layout/cache exact, no production change.'),indent=2)+'\n')
